title: Plain words confirm a shared meaning

captions.emotions: Feeling supported by a recognised promise

meaning: You can state mutual promises clearly and feel their weight when open speech expresses a meaning both people understand.
text: Familiar supportive words become more dependable when the participation behind them is clear. The Emperor in the physical position of Vishuddha helps formulate a promise without ambiguity: naming the question, clarifying terms and answering on substance. The Sun in energy supports openness and warm involvement, leaving less of what matters to be guessed. The Hierophant in emotions gives support through a promise whose meaning both people recognise. A precise word can strengthen trust when a living person and a present request remain behind the accepted form.

For example, you discuss what “supporting you with an important conversation” means. One person asks directly for a prepared speech to be heard beforehand; the other clarifies whether help with possible questions is needed. **Shared meaning grows stronger through openly named details.** You can make an understandable promise and feel its seriousness without a solemn tone. Support becomes recognisable when it is needed.

The difficulty is feeling reassured by suitable wording before the final important detail has been heard. Support seems promised already and a new request sounds like doubt about sincerity. Speaking openly remains a good intention. Freedom to clarify a familiar word preserves its weight better than requiring trust in a general phrase regardless of the particular situation.
